name: comp-321

frames.best_why: Dialog fully open on its bright white Subscribe button, before the email field takes a typed value.

tagline: Click Newsletter and a dark dialog asks for an email to subscribe.
summary: A compact newsletter signup. A trigger button opens a centred dialog with an email field, a full-width Subscribe button and a short privacy note.
appearance: A small outlined Newsletter button sits alone on a dark stage. Clicked, it opens a dark rounded dialog with a ring icon, a bold headline, a grey subtitle, an email field with a mail glyph, a wide light Subscribe button and a tiny underlined privacy line.
behaviour: The trigger opens the dialog over a dimmed backdrop. The email field accepts typing, the close X dismisses the dialog, and the Subscribe button fills the panel width.
demo_content: Placeholder email hi@yourcompany.com; in one frame the field reads maya@northwind.dev.
search_phrases: mailing list form in a modal
ask for email with a subscribe button
button that opens a newsletter form
use_when: The newsletter signup should stay secondary, hidden behind a button until the visitor chooses to open it.
avoid_when: A modal blocks the page; for a persistent signup use a footer form or an inline field instead.
customise: Headline, subtitle, placeholder and privacy copy are hardcoded, so new wording means editing the file; the trigger label and button styling come from shared components.
weight_why: One dialog with a single input and two buttons, animated only on open and close.

a11y.note: Dialog title, description and an email aria-label are set, but Subscribe is type button with no submit, success or error state.

issues: Subscribe is type button, so the form never submits anything.
polish_why: Centred layout, clear type scale and one strong action; the ring icon reads a little ambiguous.
